summary: Narrow retest of the searchable driver picker on the Pulse Fitness Fleet register vehicle modal. All 6 scenarios in the review request pass: (1) login + nav to Operations→Staffing→Vehicles→Fleet register works; (2) opening BT75NDG modal shows a DriverPicker (vm-driver-select) that opens a search input (vm-driver-search) with filterable options (vm-driver-option-<id>); typing 'Hen' correctly filters to Craig Henshall (typing 'Cra' also matches); (3) selecting Craig Henshall updates the picker button label, Save (vm-save) persists, and the register card now reads 'Craig Henshall' instead of the imported 'Lee Somers'; reopening the modal shows the picker preselected with Craig Henshall (link persists via driver_staff_ids -> driver_names); (4) 'Imported driver: Lee Somers — search above to link them to a staff member.' hint (vm-driver-hint) is visible when no staff is linked but driver_label exists; hint disappears once linked; (5) clearing back to Unassigned via the '— Unassigned —' option + Save works (register card falls back to the imported driver_label Lee Somers); (6) rest of the modal (Vehicle details, Assigned driver, Lease & finance, Fuel card & tolls, Legal & service) renders and Save works. Vehicle BT75NDG was left linked to Craig Henshall at end of test (per the request).

issues: Minor: the picker button shows a stray '▾' character appended to the selected name in accessible text (e.g. 'Craig Henshall▾'); cosmetic only, not a functional bug.

critical_code_review_comments: DriverPicker is correctly implemented with debounced-free client-side filter over drivers[] using full_name/department/job_title (case-insensitive).

Clear (X) uses stopPropagation and calls pick('') → correctly resets primary_driver_staff_id to null and driver_staff_ids to []. Save PATCHes and register card falls back to driver_label when no staff linked. Good.
vm-driver-hint is only shown when !primary_driver_staff_id && f.driver_label — correct behaviour.

Frontend dev-server previously OOM'd (webpack heap OOM); required `supervisorctl restart frontend`. Consider raising NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size for the frontend supervisor entry to reduce flakiness in preview env.
seed_data_creation: None. Left BT75NDG linked to Craig Henshall as instructed.
